Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon - Excalibur Edition

name: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon - Excalibur Edition
summary:
Excalibur Edition bundles the complete Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon experience—base game, expansions, and extras—into a single collection. Play a mature, first‑ and third‑person open‑world dark fantasy RPG inspired by Arthurian myth, explore 50–70 hours across vast zones with branching narratives and deep side quests, and expand your journey with the Sanctuary of Sarras story content (new regions, 20+ dungeons, epic bosses, 100+ items, and a flexible three‑tree progression system).
The edition also includes the Supporter’s Pack (soundtrack, digital artbook, Golden Horse Armor) and free bonus DLC with new item sets and alternate character looks, offering a fully loaded, lore‑rich adventure with extensive customization and replayability.
